  {"step": 4, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "Demangle", "line": 1326, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "InitState(&state, mangled, out, out_size);", "note": "state.mangled_cur is set to point at the start of the small VLA Buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseTopLevelMangledName", "line": 1304, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "if (ParseMangledName(state))", "note": "ParseMangledName matches the '_Z' prefix of the attacker input and advances mangled_cur past it."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseEncoding", "line": 490, "var": "state.mangled_cur", "code": "if (ParseName(state) && ParseBareFunctionType(state))", "note": "ParseEncoding invokes ParseName, which routes through ParseUnscopedName -> ParseUnqualifiedName -> ParseSourceName on the remaining input."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseSourceName", "line": 609, "var": "length", "code": "if (ParseNumber(state, &length) && ParseIdentifier(state, length))", "note": "ParseNumber parses the 12-digit string '444444444444'; the 32-bit int overflows and wraps to the large positive value 2062812956, which is stored in length."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseSourceName", "line": 609, "var": "length", "code": "ParseIdentifier(state, length)", "note": "The overflowed length 2062812956 is passed to ParseIdentifier as the identifier length."},
  {"step": 9, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "ParseIdentifier", "line": 694, "var": "length", "code": "if (length == -1 || !AtLeastNumCharsRemaining(state->mangled_cur, length))", "note": "ParseIdentifier calls AtLeastNumCharsRemaining with the huge length 2062812956."},
  {"step": 10, "file": "glog/src/demangle.cc", "function": "AtLeastNumCharsRemaining", "line": 175, "var": "str[i]", "code": "for (ssize_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) { if (str[i] == '\\0') ... }", "note": "The loop reads n=2062812956 bytes from str, which points into the Size+1-byte VLA Buffer; reading beyond Buffer[Size] triggers the dynamic-stack-buffer-overflow READ 1."}
]
EOF
python3 -c "import json; d=json.load(open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')); print('Valid JSON, steps:', len(d))"
